bias.en: Bearish · faded from $311, new 52-week low at $289.77
bias.zh: 看空 · 自 $311 回落，盘中创 52 周新低 $289.77

read.en: Broadcom edged up 0.7% on Nov 6 to $293.69 but faded from a $311.13 open, trading $289.77–311.52 on heavy volume. It is below all its averages, all falling: the 5-day ($313.0), 10-day ($325.9), 30-day ($341.1), 100-day ($367.2) and 200-day ($367.1). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 2, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($347.44), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 博通 11月6日微涨 0.7%，收于 $293.69，但自开盘价 $311.13 大幅回落，盘中区间 $289.77–311.52，成交量明显放大。股价位于所有均线下方，且均线全部下行：5 日（$313.0）、10 日（$325.9）、30 日（$341.1）、100 日（$367.2）和 200 日均线（$367.1）。MACD 于 11月2日下穿信号线，位于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$347.44），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The gap higher failed at $311.5, under the $314–316.3 resistance, and the $289.77 low marginally undercut the $289.96 Mar 30 low for a new 52-week low, though the close held above $290. Resistance is $300, then $311.5–316.3 (Nov 6 high, 5-day, Jan–Feb lows) and $319.3–321.9. Support is $289.8–290, then $281.6–281.9 (Aug 2025 lows). A close above $300 would target $311–316; below $289.8, $282.

r.en: Nov 6 high $311.5; 5-day average $313.0; Nov 5 high $314.0; Feb 17 low $316.3
